en_how: A heightmap is computed from fractal noise and Three.js instanced meshes place uniform cubes column by column (only the top few layers): grass on top, earth on the sides, sand near the waterline; each cube is darkened by how many neighbours surround it as a cheap ambient occlusion, trees, flowers and a little house with glowing windows are built from the same cubes, and a translucent water plane sits at a fixed level; three shots re-light the same world with different environment maps, fog and lights (morning, blue hour, rain), with the rain shot adding a grey overlay and code-drawn rain streaks.
